basic_info.description: Elegant home with 137.5'deep lot overlooking Palace of Fine Arts. Central Foyer rich in architectural detailing. Gracious Living Room with recessed lights, Shuttered Bay of south-facing windows, Wood-burning Fireplace with Marble Surround. Large Formal Dining Room with a Barrel Vault Ceiling. Eat-in Kitchen opens to a large deck and a beautiful garden. Upper Level: 3 Bedrooms, 2 Bathrooms: Primary Bedroom, with ensuite bath, is positioned to enjoy a stunning night view of the Palace of Fine Arts. Two additional bedrooms. Central Bathroom with a skylight and both a tub and a shower. Garden Level: 1 Car Garage. Storage. Laundry. Family Room opens to the garden.
